hooks.name: API Contract Sync Reminder
hooks.description: On api-gateway source changes, injects a prompt to review Flutter (Dio) and Next.js (React Query) client code that consumes the changed contract. No auto codegen pipeline exists.

action.prompt: An api-gateway source file was just changed. If this change modifies an HTTP route, request/response shape, WebSocket message structure, or a zod validation schema, identify the client-side code that consumes it and would break: the Flutter passenger app (apps/passenger-mobile, Dio HTTP calls and model classes) and the Next.js operator web app (apps/operator-web, React Query hooks and TypeScript types in src/lib, src/hooks, src/types). List the specific client files and fields that must be updated to stay in sync. Note: this repo has no OpenAPI/ts-rest/openapi-generator pipeline, so updates are manual. Do not edit files unless asked.
